subfamily: Jack Rose (Codex p. 129, CLASSIC): apple brandy, measured fresh lime (or lemon, by taste), grenadine made from pomegranate juice and sugar, shaken, served up
_status: v2 (Tomas, rework round 4 step 1, 2026-10-06). Replaces the vodka Collins v1 (archived: work/regular-guy-ruler/mixologist-spec-collins-v1-2026-10-06.json), which Tomas ruled the same cocktail as Not Too Polite's Tom Collins under check 3 (D12). Codex p. 129 Jack Rose: 1 1/2 oz Laird's 100-proof straight apple brandy + 1/2 oz 2-year apple brandy, 3/4 oz lime, 3/4 oz House Grenadine; at 22.5 ml of our pomegranate syrup (71 g/100 ml, computed, unsourced) it reads OUT on sugar (9.89 g), so the syrup is 17.5 ml and the lime 20 ml.
